title: Injectable Influenza Vaccine
description: The Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support is soliciting for the supply of Injectable Influenza Vaccine for the 2027-2028 flu season. Approximately 1.5 million doses are included in this requirement. (Quantities may increase or decrease pending receipt of final Service requirements.) The vaccines shall be in prefilled syringes presentation. The vaccine shall be FDA-approved for the following age categories: for immunizing individuals 65 years and older, for immunizing individuals 18 years and older, for immunizing individuals 3 years and older, and for immunizing 6 months to 35 months (pediatric group). The formula for the 2027-2028 season shall be determined by the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee. Other specification data is included in the solicitation. Successful contractor must have FDA Approval, and the vaccine must be U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) recommended. National Stock Numbers shall be established at the time of award. An indefinite quantity contract is proposed. The quantity indicated is an annual estimate only. The guaranteed minimum will be 75% of the annual estimate, and a contract maximum will be established at 150% of the annual estimate. All quantities shall be delivered to the Defense Depot New Cumberland, PA. The contractor shall be capable of delivering 40% of the requirement by August 12, 2027, 25% by August 26, 2027, 25% by September 9, 2027, and the residual 10% by September 23, 2027. This delivery schedule is the preferred delivery schedule. Other delivery schedules may be considered. A copy of the solicitation will be posted to the DLA Bid Board System (DIBBS) at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil and SAM.gov at https://www.sam.gov. Interested parties should contact Rosbert Jones (445-737-1254) (Rosbert.Jones@dla.mil) for any questions/comments. Interested parties are further advised to set up automated notifications of presolicitation or solicitation changes through this website. The current projected solicitation date is October of 2026. DLA reserves the right to issue the solicitation before or after the projected solicitation date.

title: CYROPHONE (cPhone)
description: NOTICE OF INTENT This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. NAVSUP FLCSD intends to award a sole-source contract. The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center San Diego (FLCSD) intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price (FFP) contract on a sole-source basis to Loggerhead Instruments (CAGE: 5KBN4, POC Email: dmann@loggerhead.com), 5342 Clark Road, Suite #187, Sarasota, FL 34233, using commercial acquisition procedures applicable to this requirement. The statutory authority for this noncompetitive action is FAR 12.102(a), Only one source is available, pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 1901. NAVSUP FLCSD intends to use commercial acquisition procedures applicable to this requirement. The Government has determined that Loggerhead Instruments is the only known responsible source capable of meeting the Government�s requirement within the required schedule and acceptable technical risk. The Government�s requirement is for the design, fabrication, integration, and delivery of a cryophone (�cPhone�) instrument to be deployed in the Arctic ice sheet in support of a new monitoring and detection system for Arctic research. The cPhone must meet the following functional performance criteria: reliable and accurate 4-channel recording sampling frequencies of at least 96 kHz bandwidth of 1 Hz to 48 kHz sensor sensitivity of 10 volts/g operation in air temperatures as low as -50 �F endurance of 12 months local storage of all raw data onboard statistical and Fourier analysis daily relay of reduced data and results via the Iridium satellite network flotation for deployment in the marginal ice zone (MIZ) The Government has determined that Loggerhead Instruments recently designed and built optical accelerometer drifters and a related 4-channel datalogger with the same general system architecture, electronics, firmware approach, telemetry concept, and deployment design as the required cPhone instrument. The Government further determined that the cPhone differs principally in the sensing element and represents an adaptation of a recently completed and validated system rather than a clean-sheet design. Award to another source would require substantial duplicative engineering effort and would introduce unacceptable schedule risk. The NAICS code for this procurement is 334519, Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 6655. The required delivery date is 1 January 2027 to allow sufficient time for bench testing and validation before a planned February/March2027 Arctic field experiment in the Beaufort Sea. This notice is issued solely for market research and to determine whether other responsible sources can meet the Government�s minimum requirements. Interested parties may submit documentation demonstrating their ability to satisfy the Government�s requirement. Questions regarding this notice must be submitted by email to Allaine Benson at allaine.g.benson.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 3:00 PM PDT on 03 September 2026. Responses, if provided, will be posted publicly through SAM.gov. Capability Statement Requirements Interested parties shall submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to satisfy the Government�s minimum requirements. At a minimum, the capability statement shall address the vendor�s technical capability, relevant experience, and ability to provide a system with 4-channel high-rate recording, 1 Hz to 48 kHz bandwidth, 10 volts/g sensor performance, 12-month Arctic endurance, local raw-data storage, onboard statistical and Fourier analysis, daily Iridium telemetry, and flotation suitable for marginal ice zone deployment. Submission Instruction Length Constraint Submissions must not exceed 6 pages in 10-point Times New Roman font. This market research is solely to determine if technical capabilities exist in the marketplace. Requests for information or submissions with only questions are not affirmative responses. The results of this assessment will help the Government determine whether qualified sources exist and inform the decision on whether to continue with sole-source procurement or pursue competition. Point of Contact Please submit capability statements by email as a Word or PDF attachment to Allaine Benson at allaine.g.benson.civ@us.navy.mil by 3:00pm PDT, 07 September 2026. Please ensure all submissions are addressed to the listed contact to avoid any delays or missed deadlines.

title: Expression of Interest: Future Employment Support
description: Reed in Partnership intends to participate in the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) Future Employment Support (FES) opportunity and is inviting organisations to express an interest in delivering the service with us. Together with our partners, we will deliver high-quality employability support that transforms people's lives and their communities. The programme will provide personalised employment support to out-of-work Universal Credit claimants, helping people overcome barriers to work and achieve sustained employment. This may include skills development, work experience, health-related employment support, self-employment guidance and employer engagement activities tailored to local labour market needs. Referrals to the programme will be made via JCPs. We encourage applications from organisations across the public, private and VCSE sectors, including SMEs. We are particularly keen to hear from organisations who can demonstrate proven experience in: - Supporting individuals into sustained employment - Delivering personalised interventions that improve employment outcomes - Employer engagement and workforce development - Supporting people with health conditions and complex barriers - Delivering services informed by local labour market needs - Innovative, proven services to support people to secure and sustain work How to Respond To support organisations of different sizes and specialisms, we are running two EOI routes: 1. EOI A: For end-to-end delivery providers For organisations with a proven track record of delivering high-performing employment services and the capacity to deliver across part or all of one or more CPAs please see here: https://forms.office.com/e/cvax9sttdA 2. EOI B: Specialist and Innovation Partners For organisations offering specialist expertise or innovative solutions that complement end-to-end provision, please see here: https://forms.office.com/e/e1tbAA1rDz To support applications, please find a full breakdown of the programme and eligible participant cohorts attached to this notice. Should you have any questions, please contact partner.network@reed.com. For more information on how we score our EOIs and work with partners please visit our website: https://reedinpartnership.co.uk/partners/. Please note - This EOI does not constitute an offer to work with your organisation but is the first stage in our selection process. Following the initial EOI stage, selected organisations may be invited to participate in market engagement events, webinars, one-to-one discussions, further information requests, due diligence activities and commercial negotiations.

title: Germany – Ancillary works for pipelines and cables – Herstellung der Kabeltrassen für die Landstromanlage Unikai
description: Es ist vorgesehen die das UNIKAI Terminal anlaufenden RoRo- und ConRo-Schiffe mit Landstrom zu versorgen, so dass die schiffseigenen Dieselgeneratoren während der Liegezeit am Kai abgeschaltet werden können und somit die lokalen Schadstoffemissionen verringert wer-den. Dafür sollen zwei Liegeplätze auf dem UNIKAI Terminal mit Systemen zur Landstromversorgung ausgerüstet werden. Die Umformerstation wird auf dem Gelände des UNIKAI Terminals errichtet. Für die Übergabe der Versorgungskabel auf die Schiffe werden zwei mobile Cable Management Systeme (CMS) errichtet. Für den Netzanschluss und die gesamte Verkabelung der Landstromanlage wird auf dem UNIKAI Terminal ein Leerrohr- und Schachtsystem errichtet. Das Gesamtprojekt ist in mehrere Vergabeeinheiten aufgeteilt. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Herstellung einer Leerrohrtrasse mit Schächten. Eine genaue Anforderungsbeschreibung ist den nachfolgenden Kapiteln zu entnehmen. 1.Herstellung der Leitungstrasse zwischen der Unikai Energiezentrale und der Umformerstation. 2.Herstellung der Leitungstrasse zwischen der Umformerstation und den CMS, ein-schließlich Leerrohre und Schächte für die Berücksichtigung zukünftiger Anschlüsse für Containerschiffe. 3.Erstellung der Ausführungsplanung für die Schächte, sowie Fertigung, Anlieferung und Einbau der Schächte.

title: CCTV Upgrade – Cowansville Institution
description: This requirement is for: The Correctional Service of Canada, Cowansville Institution in the Quebec Region. Trade agreement: Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), World Trade Organisation-Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-AGP), Canada Ukraine Free-Trade Agreement (CUFTA), Canada Korea Trade Agreement (CKTA), Canada free trade agreements with Chile/Colombia/Honduras/Panama, Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement, Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and Canada-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement (Canada-UK TCA), Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP). Competitive Procurement Strategy: lowest priced compliant bid. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous Suppliers. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: This procurement is not subject to a Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement. Security Requirements: This contract does not include security requirements. Nature of Requirements: This RFP is only for pre-qualified Suppliers for Work Stream Video Surveillance Supply Arrangement E60HN-24VSSA. The following SA Holders have been invited to submit a proposal: • 360 Advanced Security Corp • Accara • ADSS 6175015 Canada Inc. • Atlantic Alarm & Sound • Bearcom Canada • Bridgecast Inc. • CamCentral Systems • CanDat Systems • Chudworth Technology Solutions • ComNet Networks and Security • Convergint Technologies • Dekker Security • Delco Security • Dyplex Communications Ltd. • Limerock Security • Maritect Investigations & Security Ltd. • Motorola Solutions Canada • Neuron Communications • Next Technology Systems • Ottawa Systems Security & Communications • Paladin Technologies • PV Services • Securmax • Tyco Integrated Fire & Security dba Johnson Controls • Underwriters Security Controls • WorldWide Security Ltd The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service Canada has a requirement to supply, deliver, install, provide systems programming, testing and commissioning, provide systems documentation, training, project management, and extended maintenance to expand the Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) System at Cowansville Institution in the Quebec Region. Objectives: The objective of this project is to install cameras, viewing stations, and all required peripheral components in order to improve the CCTV coverage of the facility. Deliverables: The Contractor must provide but not limited to the following deliverables: • Technical data sheets for all installed products. • Supply, deliver and install the following equipment, as referenced in (15231-93210 Cameras Cowansville – Listing): Item Location Description Quantity Spare Parts Quantity 001 Cowansville Fixed box camera 44 4 002 Cowansville PTZ camera 5 1 003 Cowansville Wide-angle dome camera 11 2 004 Cowansville 360° panoramic / multi-sensor camera 15 2 005 Cowansville 43-inch viewing monitor (2560 × 1440) 11 2 006 Cowansville NVUS workstation 2 1 007 Cowansville 24-port network switches 2 1 Any conditions for participation of suppliers not specified in solicitation documentation: none. Duration of Contract and Time Frame for Delivery: Period of the Contract: The Work is to be performed during the period of October 1, 2026 to February 15, 2027. File Number: 21120-27-5437887 Contracting Authority: Stéphanie Gigoux Telephone number: (343) 574-3715 E-mail: stephanie.gigoux@csc-scc.gc.ca NOTE TO BIDDERS: Bidders can obtain copies of the solicitation documents by contacting the contracting authority named in this notice. title: Elevator Maintenance Services, Iqaluit HQ, Iqaluit, NU
description: Description: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police in Iqaluit, Nunavut Territories, has a requirement for Elevator Maintenance Services at the RCMP Iqaluit Headquarters Building. This procurement is subject to the Nunavut Land Claims Agreement and the Directive on Government Contracts, Including Real Property Leases, in the Nunavut Settlement Area. Bidders are requested to maximize Inuit employment, subcontracting and on-the-job training opportunities, and involve Inuit businesses, in carrying out the work under this project. The Nunavut Agreement contains a provision requiring the inclusion of socio-economic bid criteria in the solicitation document, when practicable and consistent with sound procurement management principles. These socio-economic bid criteria are referred to as Nunavut Benefits Criteria (NBC) and Inuit Benefits Criteria (IBC), and bidders propose Inuit benefits in their bid submission via an Inuit Benefits Plan (IBP). Policy on Reciprocal Procurement This solicitation of bids is open only to Canadian suppliers and to Suppliers of an applicable trading partner. Delivery Date: The contract period will be for 36-months from the date of contract. Security: This requirement contains a security requirement. Basis of selection: A bid must comply with all the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory requirements. Bids not meeting the requirements will be declared non-responsive. The selection will be based on the highest responsive combined rating of total Inuit Benefits Plan (IBP) merit, and price. The ratio will be 35% for the total IBP merit, and 65% for price. Tenders must be submitted to the RCMP Bid Receiving Unit at: NWR_Procurement_Bids@rcmp-grc.gc.ca Refer to the attached tender documents to obtain further information. Canada retains the right to negotiate with any supplier on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. The RCMP has adopted the Integrity Regime administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada. As a result, the integrity provisions are being applied in RCMP contracting activities as outlined in this solicitation. Canada will make available Notices of Proposed Procurement (NPP), bid solicitations and related documents for download through the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) at https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities . Canada is not responsible and will not assume any liabilities whatsoever for the information found on websites of third parties. In the event an NPP, bid solicitation or related documentation would be amended, Canada will not be sending notifications. Canada will post all amendments, including significant enquiries received and their replies, using GETS. It is the sole responsibility of the Bidder to regularly consult GETS for the most up-to-date information. Canada will not be liable for any oversight on the Bidder's part nor for notification services offered by a third party. Indigenous Procurement: The federal Indigenous Business Directory (IBD) is an online resource for all levels of government and the private sector to identify Indigenous business capacity. Having a business profile in the IBD will increase your company’s visibility and may provide additional business. A profile in the IBD can also allow you to compete for federal government contracts that are set-aside for Indigenous businesses through the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Businesses. For more information and to review eligibility criteria and register, visit: www.canada.ca/indigenousbusinessdirectory.

description: SECTION A � Streamlined Solicitation for Commercial Items This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for the acquisition of commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this announcement. The Contractor will deliver services over standard circuit-switched systems and digital circuit services for Kayenta Health Center, Inscription House Health Center and Dennehotso Health Station. This request will also include minor hardware and software changes/installation required to support the changing business role of Kayenta Service Unit, minor maintenance to hardware supporting the operations of telecommunication services for the Service Unit and for continued support of the system. Section B � Products or Services and Prices/Costs B.1 BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SERVICES The business objective of telecommunication service is maintaining continuity of critical and timely services between Kayenta Service Unit, all NAIHS facilities, non-IHS facilities, patients, and Area Office customers in healthcare, financial and cooperative relationships with partners and agencies on and off the Navajo Reservation. The services required support the Indian Health Services Mission to raise the physical, mental, social, and spiritual health of American Indians and Alaska Natives to the highest level, including behavioral health care and long-term care for the local Native American population. Services allow Kayenta Service Unit to: Increase health care service availability and accessibility Improve health care quality, safety, cost and value Broaden health insurance and long-term care coverage Recruit, develop and retain a competent health care workforce Keep current on technological advances and innovation The Kayenta Service Unit Division of Information Technology aligns its operations, technical direction and management to support the Navajo Area Indian Health Service Strategic plan, Mission and Business Objectives. Delivery of government and industry IT services and systems to clinical and administrate programs via telecommunication services. Support IT and Telecommunication technologies under the Federal Enterprise Architecture, GSA Services, and Verizon networks. Support transparency and transformation of IT and telecommunication services and systems to and between customer endpoints. B.2 TYPE OF CONTRACT The contract type is Firm Fixed Price contract. description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes as the only solicitation. Quotes are being requested and a written solicitation is attached. Solicitation number W913E526QA004 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for Antarctic Airfield Rescue and Firefighting (ARFF) Fire Suppression System. This requirement is a total set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov/faroverhaul. The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Cold Regions Research and Engineering Laboratory (CRREL), Engineering Research Branch (ERB) has a requirement for delivery and installation of six (6) Compressed Air Foam System (CAFS) firefighting systems for integration as complete Antarctic Airfield Rescue and Firefighting (ARFF) vehicles. The Contractor shall also provide training on operation of the suppression systems and will be required to ship the completed systems to a to be determined CONUS integration contractor facility. Product Specifications: A partly custom solution is required consisting of commercially available wheeled and tracked, low ground pressure, 7.5-ton payload vehicles that will have separate, integrated commercially available fire suppression systems. This requirement is for the fire suppression portion of the total ARFF solution. Some minor modification of these commercial products may be necessary to meet the needs of Antarctic functionality, specifically to ensure mechanical systems operate down to -30F. Please reference the attached RFQ W913E526QA008 for instructions and applicable provisions and clauses. The Government intends to award a firm-fixed-price contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer represents the Best Value, considering price and non-price factors. The basis for award will be an acceptable quote, the price of which may not be the lowest.The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers: 1) Technical capability to comply with specification, delivery requirements, and warranty provisions as outlined in Section C, Description of Requirement (DOR). 2) Past experience and competency in the nature of the requested mission. 3) Total price to fulfill the Government�s requirement in its entirety. Price will be evaluated for reasonableness and completeness. A technically acceptable quote is one that clearly represents the ability to satisfy the minimum specified requirements outlined in Section C, DOR and the quote submission instructions outlined in Section L, Instructions to Offerors. The quote shall provide sufficient information for the Government to determine its level of confidence in the ability of the Offeror to meet the requirements. Quotes that are ambiguous or are missing required information may be disqualified. Quotes are intended to be evaluated, and award made, without discussions with offerors (other than discussions conducted for the purpose of minor clarifications) but the Government reserves the right to conduct discussions if necessary. FOB Destination: CRREL, 72 Lyme Road, Hanover, NH 03755 Payment Terms: Net 30 Please provide responses to this notice, no later than Tuesday, September 8, 2026,12:00 PM, Central Daylight Time (CDT) to: . Kim.D.Roberson@usace.army.mil Telephone responses will not be accepted. *Note: To be eligible for award of a Government contract, vendors must be actively registered in the System for Award Management (SAM), have no active exclusions, and complete representations and certifications. For more information, review the SAM website at https://www.sam.gov.

title: Gifford Pinchot National Forest - Fire Trailer Tank Assembly
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for a commercial product prepared in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 12 and RFO Subpart 5.2. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested.This requirement incorporates provisions and clauses in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01. Requirement Description The U.S. Forest Service, Gifford Pinchot National Forest, Wind River Ranger District, requires the procurement of a brand new, commercial-grade Fire Trailer Tank and Pump Assembly. Critical Procurement Constraint: The Government currently owns the tandem-axle utility trailer (5�x10�, 7,000 lbs GVWR). This requirement is strictly for the fully integrated skid unit that bolts onto the existing frame. Exclusions: This acquisition explicitly does not include the purchase of a new trailer chassis, wheels, axles, tongue, or towing coupler. Technical Specifications & Salient Characteristics The skid unit must conform to the following core baselines: Tank Structure: Minimum 500-gallon capacity; heavy-duty 10-gauge carbon steel. Internal anti-surge baffles and interior epoxy coating required. Footprint & Weight: Maximum 5�x10� footprint matching the structural channel layout of the government owned trailer. Total assembly dry weight must not exceed 2,300 lbs. Pump Assembly: 13 HP commercial gas engine paired with a twin-impeller portable centrifugal pump delivering ? 120 GPM @ 40 PSI and ? 20 GPM @ 146 PSI. Drafting & Plumbing: Integrated 2-inch manifold with self-loading/drafting system. Includes 2" x 20' suction hose with foot valve/strainer and a manual hand primer pump. Discharges: 2-inch quarter-turn ball valve main discharge. Valved auxiliary ports in 1-inch, 1.5-inch, and 3/4-inch configurations. Accessories: Manual-wind hose reel loaded with 250 feet of 1-inch utility hose and adjustable nozzle. Integrated lockable rear toolbox, shackle tie-down points, and integrated fenders/mud flaps matching tandem-axle placement. Aesthetics: Tank may be painted red but must not feature any fire use decals or markings. ******See Attached Solictation for Salient Characterisitcs******** Place of Performance/ Timelines Delivery/Production Timeline: Full manufacturing, plumbing, leak pressure testing, and final inspection availability must occur within thirty (30) calendar days from receipt of order (ARO). FOB Delivery Address: Wind River Work Center, 1262 Hemlock Road, Carson, WA 98610. Government Pickup Option: If the contractor�s manufacturing facility sits within a 100-mile driving radius of Carson, WA (98610), the Government reserves the right to execute a local pickup. Evaluation Framework & Basis for Award Award will be made to the responsible offeror representing the most advantageous solution to the Government under the simplified procedures of FAR 12.203. The following factors will be evaluated: Technical Acceptability: Exact matching of technical baselines or validated technical justifications for proposed "or equal" elements. Delivery Timeline: Confirmed ability to meet the mandatory 30-day target. Price: Fair and reasonable evaluation. Submission Protocol Quoters must maintain an Active SAM.gov Registration. Offers omitting a Unique Entity ID (UEI) will be immediately excluded from evaluation. Prices must remain firm for 90 calendar days from the submission deadline. Required Package Components: Completed and signed SF-1449 (Blocks 17a, 30a, 30b, and 30c). Phone, Email, and SAM UEI within Block 17a. Completed unit costs and totals within the Schedule of Items.
